near_duplicates.method: 1200-character nonoverlapping chunks, mean pooled and L2 normalized; cosine >=0.92; candidate similarity, not proof of syndication

timezone: RSS feedparser parsed offsets into UTC; API naive ISO dates default UTC (C1). UTC inclusive calendar date window; no inferred publication dates.

entity_extraction.method: spaCy en_core_web_sm 3.8.0; ORG/PERSON/PRODUCT; fixed common-organisation EntityRuler, technical-acronym exclusion list, deterministic alias map; no LLM. QA only, not used by the RAG system.
entity_extraction.limitations: Small general-domain NER misses products and acronyms, may label generic phrases as organisations. Counts are estimates, not graph entity-linking ground truth.

entity_audit.reviewer: implementation agent, direct reading; no LLM extraction/judge calls
entity_audit.scope: First 1100 clean-text characters of each fixed-seed sample item; complete text for shorter summaries. Full-document predicted names restricted to whole-name presence in that prefix. Titles excluded from entity scoring. Validity requires an organisation, person or product referent in context; partial names and aliases counted as valid when unambiguous, duplicates not penalised. Missed-name examples are qualitative, not exhaustive; no recall claim. This is not a held-out NER benchmark.
entity_audit.conclusion: Organisation anchors are useful, but product recall, alias fragmentation and cover-page/legal boilerplate errors prevent treating raw overlap counts as gold entity-linking labels. Manually validate entities used for future questions.

manual_review_notes.provenance_caveat: Initial reachability probes preceded the complete robots/terms review. Those probe responses are not corpus inputs unless separately fetched by the policy-enforcing collector. The collection client denies blocked sources and never uses the prohibited discovery responses as backfill.
